definitions.explanation: The place where someone or something is, especially when unknown or being searched for.
Where something is headed or how a situation will develop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{行方|ゆくえ}{不明|ふめい}→行方不明：14039_yukuefumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{行方|ゆくえ}⟦{不明者|ふめいしゃ}→不明者：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {行方|ゆくえ} is often used in news reports and formal contexts when discussing missing persons or uncertain outcomes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{行方|ゆくえ}{不明|ふめい}→行方不明：14039_yukuefumei⟧ (missing, whereabouts unknown)
- {行方|ゆくえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧ (to track whereabouts)
- {行方|ゆくえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捜|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to search for whereabouts)
- {行方|ゆくえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (whereabouts unknown)
- {行方|ゆくえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧ (to watch how things develop)

- ⟦{居場所|いばしょ}→居場所：12366_ibasho⟧ - location, place to be
